caption: The drawing depicts a geometric composition made up of numerous small hexagonal shapes arranged in a tessellated pattern, forming larger hexagonal and circular motifs. The design features a varied color palette, including shades of red, blue, green, brown, yellow, pink, and cream. Each hexagonal shape contains intricate, often floral or patterned designs, contributing to the overall complexity of the image. The motifs are grouped in repeating and concentric arrangements, some forming star shapes or flower-like forms within the hexagonal framework. The background is bordered by a plain, off-white or cream color which frames the main patterned area. The overall composition is highly detailed and symmetrical, with the hexagonal modules tightly fitted together, and the colors distributed in such a way as to highlight the distinct shapes and larger patterns within the design.
title: Patchwork Quilt
